Results.ReviewText: I've had quite a few cheaper gas grills over the decades and was somewhat disappointed with all of them.  None lasted very long and they didn't heat evenly.  Finally decided to treat myself to a Weber Spirit E-310.  I've had it for three weeks and have grilled salmon, shish kabobs and veggies as well as burgers and hot dogs.  The heat is very even and the gas controls are very precise.  Grilling takes less time and cleaning of the grates is very easy.  The grill looks good, too!  Overall, I am extremely pleased.

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello Kacie, we are very sorry to hear about this issue! Please be sure to start your grill following the steps below. If you continue to have issues be sure to reach out to our support team! We will be happy to assist you! Thanks! 
1. Open the lid
2. Make sure all knobs are in the off position (including side burner if applicable)
3. Turn your LP tank on all the way
4. Wait 30-60 seconds
5. Turn the first burner to start/high (first position to the left)
6. Hit your igniter
7. Turn on all remaining burners
8. Close the lid to preheat to 500-550°F

Results.ReviewText:
I like this grill a lot. Read a bunch of reviews before purchasing. Here are my thoughts. Assembly was pretty easy. Parts and pieces well defined. Instructions were well done. Pictures made it easy. Took about 45 minutes.
The Grill
Have used it 6 times in the last two weeks. Heats up fast. No flare ups. Steaks on one side of grill grates burgers on the other. Solid tapered walls with a bottom tray (that usually rusts through on other grills) that is removable for cleaning.  Like that. Also easily removable and replaceable grease tray. So far so good.

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
